# Escrow
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/intent-system/src/contracts/Escrow.sol)

**Inherits:**
ReentrancyGuard, [IEscrow](../interfaces/i-escrow.md)

**Title:**
Escrow

Simple token holding contract for escrowing yield

Can be deployed from IntentHandler for each solver

The IntentHandler that this escrow works with

address public immutable intentHandler
```

mapping(bytes32 intentId => uint256 amount) public intentAmounts
```
